lines.text: OAK: Oh! Just one more thing!
Now that you two are setting out as Trainers,\nI’d like to ask your help with something.\c\nTake this with you on your journeys.
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: What is that thing, Professor?

OAK: This is the Pokédex that I’ve designed!\c
It automatically records data on Pokémon you’ve
seen or caught, and it makes an entry for each.\c
It’s an extremely high-tech tool!
[VAR TRNAME(0000)] and [VAR TRNAME(0001)]...\nI want you each to take one with you!
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokédex[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Professor Oak!

OAK: You’ll find you can’t get very detailed data
on Pokémon by just seeing them.\c
You must catch a Pokémon to gather the most
complete data!
To make a complete guide to all the Pokémon\nin the world...\c\nThat was my dream!
But I’m an old man now!\nToo old to get the job done myself.
That’s why I want you young Trainers to fulfill\nmy dream for me!
Get moving, you two!\c\nThis is a great undertaking in Pokémon history!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: A Pokédex, huh?\c\nWe’re gonna meet so many Pokémon...\nThis keeps getting better and better!
I’m setting out right now!\n[VAR TRNAME(0000)], you should do the same...\r\nIf you think you’re ready, that is!
OAK: Pokémon are out there waiting for you—\nthe whole world over, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
